snippet.title: Inquisitor - GGJ 2018 Theme "Transmission"
snippet.description:
Play the game here!
https://achebit.itch.io/inquisitor

This years Global Game Jam theme was "Transmission" so i made a little game about assimilants (robot spies) transmitting mission data.

They game is inspired by "Resistance" and adds a few more mechanics to fill in the social gameplay lost through digitising it into a one player game.
